desc: The legendary R95 Triple Black goes compact. The new lever-action TBP lineup delivers the same rugged black Cerakote finish, paracord-wrapped medium loop, and threaded barrel—now in a pistol format. Available in hard-hitting calibers like .454 Casull, .45-70 Govt, .44 Mag, and .357 Mag. Compact, capable, and ready for anything.
